cohort: The study included 7635 singleton term newborns without fetal structural anomalies born at Adolfo Guevara Velazco National Hospital at 3400 m above sea level.
finding: Reference curves for the 3rd, 10th, 50th, 90th, and 97th percentiles of weight, height, head circumference (HC), ponderal index (PI), and HCBWI were developed for term newborns according to sex born at 3400 m above sea level.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between January 2005 and December 2010.
